newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African 1997/98 budget seen fractionally lower.
newsitem.headline: S.African 1997/98 budget seen fractionally lower.

text.p: The Finance Department said on Tuesday that the 1997/98 budget would be marginally lower than the original estimate of 186,746.8 million rand because of lower than expected spending on the new Durban academic hospital.

It said in an explanatory memorandum that 226.8 million rand would be spent on the hospital, which was 188,000 rand less than the original estimate. This would bring the budget down to 186,746.6 million rand
The new hospital will replace the King Edward VII Hospital which has been condemned as being unsuitable for academic training.
